reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown take Deuteronomy 5:4's face to face as the directness of Yahweh's speech, not a visible form, consistent with 4:12's denial that any shape was seen.

sides.snippet: Yahweh spoke to you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; only [you heard] a voice.
sides.verseText: Yahweh spoke to you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; only [you heard] a voice.

sides.snippet: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the midst of the fire,
